title: Juicy Sweet Middle Eastern Cheese Knafeh
description: A sweet and gooey Middle Eastern dessert featuring tarragon leaves and tempering chocolate, this dish is a nostalgic treat for many. It is halal friendly and made in the traditional knafeh form.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
Combine the akawi cheese, tarragon leaves, and rose water in a bowl.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with ghee.
Add the cheese mixture to the phyllo dough and fold the dough over the cheese.
Bake the knafeh for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Melt the tempering chocolate and pour it over the knafeh.
Combine the sugar and water in a saucepan and boil until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the sugar syrup over the knafeh and serve.
Let the knafeh cool for 10 minutes before serving.
